model.title: A resolution to authorize testimony and representation by the Senate Legal Counsel.

summary.text: The resolution would authorize the Senate Legal Counsel to provide testimony and legal representation in matters involving the Senate or its members, allowing the chamber's legal office to appear before courts or other proceedings as needed.
